oracle.scope: Original selective final M1 proof independently on every branch: complete namespace/kinds/lengths/aliases, original explicit file attributes and measured created directory modes, full sub-128KiB bytes and original declared large-file ranges; every actual CommitID/parent and final branch head/root; summed original per-stage/cycle counters; two-worker A discarded witness absent in final declared state. No exhaustive Phase1 or all-intermediate-payload claim.
oracle.roots: Common initial Layer plus every acknowledged local Commit, distinct actual CommitIDs with first parentNone per branch and subsequent own-chain parents; exact final head/root on each branch; root identities may repeat
oracle.omissions: Automatic mtime is not normalized; only original explicitly declared attributes/ranges are constrained. Original regular intermediate payload scopes and optional exhaustive Phase1 replay are not selected. Retired host Store RSS/spool domains and complete cache qualification unavailable.

differences: Current public SDK control opens the explicitly selected Disposable/WAL/OFF Store in the Linux daemon; the overlay remains MEMORY/OFF/EXCLUSIVE. Retired host-mediated topology, encoding and historical pure-call clock remain archival context.
All measured Commits use construction_workers=1. Init retains its supported parallel profile. Original fixtures, ranks, seed, payload recipes, operation order and limits are unchanged.

Class B/C qualifies only the named daemon/kernel regime. Independent pre-phase OS backing, kernel metadata, SQLite/reader and own-write coldness evidence is unavailable under H-5; numeric results are INELIGIBLE. No cache treatment is changed to obtain eligibility.

Original two/four host workers and distinct simultaneous mounts share one Linux daemon/container and global Store; current public ProjectApi fork/history and WorkspaceApi control use authenticated channels, with host control only and one daemon overlay namespaced per Workspace. One construction worker per Commit; original Workspace concurrency is preserved.

P3 uses ordinary FUSE edits: unchanged fourteen native stage2 targets followed by the original two ordered prepared ordinary single-file members, never an atomic batch. Branch context changes only the original explicit tag/salt metadata and native recipe parameters.

Frozen executable uses worker-start barriers per segment, not per-stage/pre-Commit barriers. Two-worker discard/reopen occurs afterK/2 (5 forK10,50 forK100), and B retains already committed state; roadmap requires fixed5/dirtyBstage6/pre-Commit barrier. Preserve these source discrepancies explicitly, without silent correction.

H17 frozen stage5 sets copied explicit mtime before writing/syncing/renaming the temporary, while the original oracle retains stage4 timestamp. Strict resulting metadata FAIL remains FAIL; no automatic normalization, oracle weakening or not-applicable classification.

Historical complete pure product-call sum aggregates parallel workers; current complete-command wall, actual public Commit overlap, per-worker records, storage and unavailable metrics are separately retained. Original15s target and60s execution declaration remain; four-workspace extension has original60s verification declaration.
